{{{{{1|Item Infobox}}} |image = Furniture Catalogue 2 |Source = [[Stardew:Stardew Valley Fair|Stardew Valley Fair]] |Type = Furniture |Sell Price = ''Cannot be sold'' |other = {{Price|9999|token}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a catalogue of new furniture and itself a type of [[Furniture]] item that can be placed indoors or outdoors. It can be purchased from the Star Token Shop at the [[Stardew:Stardew Valley Fair|Stardew Valley Fair]] for {{Price|9999|token}}. Once purchased and placed, interacting with the catalogue allows players to obtain any of the furniture items within it, working similarly to that of the vanilla [[Stardew:Catalogue|Catalogue]] or Furniture Catalogue. {{Info|For clarity on vanilla game mechanics, visit [[Stardew:Furniture Catalogue|Stardew Valley wiki - Furniture Catalogue]].}} ==Available Furniture== {{Main|Furniture}} ==History== * v.1.15: Introduced {{clear}}
